scope: Exercise each direct low-level SURFACE serializer's exact runtime-type gate in both DXF encodings.

implementation.failureBehavior: Each matching-tag derived subtype is refused before record publication and leaves a prewritten destination prefix unchanged.
implementation.retryBehavior: A fresh low-level writer accepts the corresponding exact built-in runtime class and emits the expected group-0 record, group-5 identity, and subtype marker. Low-level writer errors remain sticky, so retry uses a fresh writer.

validation.input: Locally authored C++ objects; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limitations: The control parses emitted group records but does not establish native consumer acceptance or semantic equivalence of surface payloads.
It does not qualify physical producer profiles, ACIS/SAB syntax, topology, graph closure, or support claims.
The exact DRW_Surface base representation for PLANESURFACE remains covered by the existing low-level plane-surface control.
